noJobsScheduled: No jobs scheduled for this date.
onlyAdminOrAssignedTechnician: Only an admin or the assigned technician can change a job's status
addRemarksAbout: Add remarks about what was done for this {jobType}.
whatDidYouDo: What did you do on this job/errand?
pendingInventoryNote: Each filter creates its own inventory transaction, kept Pending until an admin approves it — actual stock isn't deducted yet.
addJobDescription: Add a technician job to the daily agenda.
addSecondTechnicianPlaceholder: Add a second technician if this job needs two
sharesSameDateNote: Shares the same date, order, and status as the primary technician below — this is one job, not two.
linksTechnicianScheduleNote: Lets this technician see the job on their own Schedule. Unrelated to the Technician field above.
linkToSecondTechnicianLogin: Link to the second technician's login
linksSecondTechnicianScheduleNote: Lets the second technician also see this shared job on their own Schedule.
bothScheduledNote: Both {technician} and {technician2} are scheduled for this date — there's a single Date field for the whole job, so changing it moves both.
secondaryAddressPlaceholder: e.g. pull-out address, if different from the install address
pageDescription: Technician job agenda across all dates.
searchByTechnicianOrderNotes: Search by technician, order no, notes...
deleteJobDescription: This will permanently remove this scheduled job.
